aiInstructions: Import moledao/styles.css once at the application entry point.
Use only documented components, props, enum values, icon names, and animated icon names.
Do not convert Button into an anchor; Button always renders a native button. Use Typography with state=link and href for the library's text-link treatment.
Prefer controlled props when application state already owns the value; otherwise use the documented default prop.
Preserve native DOM attributes and event handlers supported by each component's inherited attribute type.
Provide required accessible names. Never use placeholder text as the only accessible name for an Input.
Use MoleProvider near the application root when theme, density, locale, motion, or runtime behavior is needed.
Treat source paths as implementation references, not public import paths.

globalUsage.styleRule: Import moledao/styles.css once; do not import internal CSS files.
globalUsage.colorBehavior: Icon, AnimatedIcon, and tone=current Spinner inherit currentColor.
globalUsage.refBehavior: Button, Input, Toggle, Icon, AnimatedIcon, and LockIcon forward refs to their primary DOM element.

Button.summary: Triggers an action with MoleDAO visual variants, sizes, loading, read-only, full-width, and icon layouts.

variant.type: primary | destructive | white-line | secondary | destructive-secondary | link | solid | outline | ghost | danger
variant.notes: solid, outline, ghost, and danger are compatibility aliases for primary, white-line, link, and destructive.

loading.notes: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy, and disables interaction.

readOnly.notes: Disables interaction and applies the read-only visual state.

showIcon.notes: Shows the built-in design icon when no custom start content is supplied.

accessibility: When iconOnly is true, provide aria-label or meaningful children; visible children are visually hidden.
loading and readOnly disable the native button.
Do not use Button as navigation because it renders a button, not an anchor.

Input.summary: Native text input with label, helper text, semantic status, adornments, clear action, and password visibility action.

label.notes: Visible label associated with the input.

helperText.notes: Connected through aria-describedby; warning helper text uses role=alert.

onValueChange.notes: Called for typing and the built-in clear action.

accessibility: Provide label or aria-label. Do not rely only on placeholder.
Use status=warning for invalid input and explain the problem with helperText.
For controlled input, update value from onValueChange so the clear action stays synchronized.
Input.example: <Input label="项目名称" value={name} onValueChange={setName} clearable />

Toggle.summary: Accessible controlled or uncontrolled boolean switch.
accessibility: label is mandatory and should describe the setting, not its current value.

Tooltip.summary: Hover/focus tooltip with four placements, horizontal alignment, Escape dismissal, and aria-describedby wiring.

children.notes: Exactly one element that accepts aria-describedby.

align.notes: Horizontal alignment for top and bottom placements.

open.notes: Controlled visibility; omit for hover/focus behavior.

accessibility: Pass one focusable child such as Button or a native button.
Do not put essential information only inside a tooltip.
The component attaches aria-describedby and closes on Escape.

Icon.summary: Static Figma-derived vector icon with currentColor and automatic or fixed stroke scaling.

strokeMode.notes: auto scales the 1.5px source stroke with size; fixed uses a non-scaling stroke.

strokeWidth.notes: Pixel width. Supplying it implicitly activates fixed mode.

--mole-icon-stroke-width.notes: May be inherited from a parent; strokeWidth overrides it inline.

accessibility: Decorative icons omit aria-label and are automatically aria-hidden.
Standalone informative icons require aria-label and receive role=img.

AnimatedIcon.summary: Registry-backed icon that animates between two states with shared speed, sound, interruption, and reduced-motion behavior.

active.notes: Selects the second state when true and animates on change.

size.notes: Named sizes are 16px, 20px, and 24px; a number is an arbitrary pixel size.

speed.notes: 2 is twice as fast, 0.5 is half speed, 0 skips motion.

duration.notes: Base milliseconds before dividing by speed; otherwise uses the selected icon's timing.

accessibility: Decorative animated icons omit aria-label and are aria-hidden.
Standalone state icons require aria-label or aria-labelledby.
MoleProvider motion=reduced and the system reduced-motion preference skip animation.
AnimatedIcon.example: <AnimatedIcon name="lock" active={locked} aria-label={locked ? '已锁定' : '未锁定'} />

accessibility: Use the same labeling rules as AnimatedIcon.

Spinner.summary: Accessible loading indicator with current or brand color.
accessibility: Use a task-specific label when the default loading announcement is ambiguous.

Typography.summary: Semantic typography levels and visual states for headings, body text, marks, links, and deletions.
Typography.renders: h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | p | span | a

level.type: h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | body-large | body | body-small | caption

state.type: default | secondary | success | warning | disabled | mark | link | delete

as.type: h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | p | span | a
as.notes: Defaults from level; state=link with href defaults to a.

accessibility: Choose heading levels by document hierarchy, not visual size alone.
For navigation, use state=link with href so an anchor is rendered.
state=disabled is visual text styling and does not disable an interactive parent.

MoleProvider.summary: Application boundary for color theme, density, locale, motion, and the Mole runtime snapshot.

locale.notes: Sets the lang attribute; otherwise inherited lang may be used.

runtime.notes: A private runtime is created when omitted.

accessibility: Prefer motion=system unless the product has an explicit user motion preference.

DeferredRender.summary: Defers rendering until a container approaches the viewport, with SSR and no-IntersectionObserver fallbacks.
accessibility: Use a meaningful fallback when delayed content is necessary to understand page progress.

createMoleRuntime.notes: Normally pass the returned runtime to MoleProvider. It is SSR-safe and observes browser capabilities and user preferences.

scheduleMoleTask.signature: (priority: 'visual' | 'background', task: () => void, options?: { timeout?: number }) => () => void

typography.--mole-font-sans: Poppins, Mole OPPO Sans, PingFang SC, sans-serif

antiPatterns: Do not import files from packages/ui/src in consumer applications.
Do not use undocumented variant strings or icon names.
Do not place interactive controls inside Tooltip content.
Do not use icon color props; set CSS color/currentColor on the icon or an ancestor.
Do not use Button for navigation.
Do not make loading state depend only on animation; Spinner includes a live label.
